description: Runs `npm test`, `pnpm test`, or `yarn test` and returns structured output with exit code, stdout, stderr, and duration. Auto-detects package manager via lock files (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm). Shorthand for running the test script defined in package.json. Automatically parses test framework output (jest, vitest, mocha, tap) to extract pass/fail/skip counts.

args.description: Additional arguments passed after -- to the test script

filter.description: pnpm workspace filter pattern (e.g., '@scope/pkg', './packages/foo'). Only used with pnpm.

ifPresent.description: Don't error if the test script is missing — useful in heterogeneous monorepos (maps to --if-present)

packageManager.description: Package manager to use. Auto-detected from lock files if not specified (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

parallel.description: Run workspace tests in parallel (maps to --parallel for pnpm)

recursive.description: Run tests in all workspace packages (maps to --recursive for pnpm, --workspaces for npm)

silent.description: Strip npm/pnpm log chrome for cleaner output (maps to --silent)

stream.description: Stream output with package name prefixes (maps to --stream for pnpm)

workspace.description: Workspace target(s) — maps to npm --workspace or pnpm --filter for unified workspace targeting

name: test

packageManager.description: Package manager that was used (npm, pnpm, or yarn)

stderr.description: Standard error from the test run

stdout.description: Standard output from the test run

testResults.description: Parsed test counts from known frameworks (jest, vitest, mocha) — best-effort

timedOut.description: Whether the test run timed out

title: Run Tests
